'''Shinomiya Yoshitoshi''' (Japanese: '''義俊四宮''' ''Yoshitoshi Shinomiya'', born 1980 in Kanagawa) is a Japanese artist. He is best known for being the background artist in ''{{wp|The Garden of Words}}'' and ''{{wp|Your Name}}''. Pokémon-wise, he recently made official visuals for Pokémon movies ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', ''[[M21|The Power of Us]]'', and ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]''.
